## Academic & Research Profile
- Institution: Rangamati Science and Technology University (RMSTU)
- Department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
- Merit Standing: 1st Position (Rank 1st), CGPA 3.96 / 4.00
- Research Focus: Vision Transformers (ViTs, DINOv2, SQAFormer), Zero-Label Cell Microscopy Anomaly Detection, Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM)
- Publications: IEEE PECCII 2026 conference publication on sustainable energy infrastructure evaluation using MCDM frameworks.
- Long-term Vision: University professor combining teaching, technical work, and machine learning research.

## Core Technical Projects
- Exam Studio: Next-generation in-browser XeLaTeX question generation system with WebAssembly compilation and live typography preview (React, TypeScript, WebAssembly).
- Teach Easy: Offline-first student assessment and attendance tracking platform tailored for classroom educators.
- CGPA Buddy: University grading policy forecaster and academic goal calculation manager.
- Question Vault RMSTU: Open-access repository indexing previous semester exam questions for university departments.
- RMSTU Transport System: Fleet vehicle tracking, bus route management, and schedule notification portal.
